findings.detail: sync_batch_manifest reads Research checkpoints only from the current evidence epoch. After a new epoch begins, an unaffected article can retain its accepted global Research head while the manifest reports it as PENDING and not writing-ready. The new-epoch failure test uses placeholder heads rather than accepted prior-epoch checkpoints and asserts zero ready articles, so it does not verify the claimed readiness preservation.
findings.required_fix: Resolve each manifest row from its current global Research head, including the originating epoch and verified completion record. Add an end-to-end test with two genuinely accepted prior heads and a failed transfer for one article; verify the other article’s status, readiness and manifest counts remain correct.

findings.detail: The independent English review receives the entire writer packet, including writer-side skill and handoff assessments and similarity QA fields. Locale review also receives that packet as its English reference. This does not satisfy the requirement to exclude writer self-evaluation; the existing test checks only for a literal self_evaluation key.
findings.required_fix: Build review inputs from an explicit allowlist of article content, immutable identity and source evidence, excluding writer-side assessments and QA conclusions. Test the actual English and locale review requests for exclusion while retaining the full evidence and rendered text.

articles.reason: The closest Q05 record is a 2024 China-market PHEV reserve, whereas this proposal targets an identified 2026 China-market BEV and its urban-buyer decision. The RHD guide mentions NEVO Q05 only as a reported Thailand prospect within broad RHD sourcing; the Southeast Asia SUV page is a shortlist method, not a Q05 model recommendation. These do not duplicate the proposed buyer intent. This is a topic-dedup finding, not final factual acceptance.

The Foton Aumark and Dongfeng Tianjin KR pages focus on vehicle configuration, chassis/body/refrigeration-unit choices, and buyer verification; the fleet guide covers broader fleet procurement, and the PDI guide covers general condition and handover evidence. The proposal is distinct only within its stated decision scope: agreeing a reefer-specific acceptance demonstration and its evidence for the completed truck, including the identified operating conditions, records, and acceptance responsibilities. It should not become another equipment-selection or generic PDI guide.

fixes_awaiting_independent_review: Manifest resolves current accepted global Research heads through their originating epoch checkpoints and verifies original immutable completion bytes and receipts; end-to-end regression uses two fully accepted prior packets and a failed transfer for only one

English and locale independent review use explicit content/identity/evidence allowlists, excluding writer skill/handoff assessments, similarity QA, production holds and previous acceptance conclusions while preserving the exact full rendered text and all source evidence

genuine_topic_reuse_offline_verified.scope: Identical buyer decisions, source evidence, corpus and rules; technical baseline SHA only
